snippet.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu | Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
Welcome to the gameplay overview for The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, a 4-player co-op Lovecraftian horror game set in a cursed jungle.

In this video, we show you how to prepare for your expedition at the galleon, guide you as you dive into the unknown of our hostile jungle, and reveal how the game's sanity system will twist your mind to sabotage your group's efforts.

The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu releases on July 15, 2026, on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2569760/The_Mound_Omen_of_Cthulhu/
